# Portable PDB fixtures

Unmodified files from public NuGet packages, used to test the portable PDB reader. Each is redistributed under its project's MIT license.

| File | From package | Shows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Ardalis.GuardClauses.pdb` | Ardalis.GuardClauses 4.5.0, `lib/netstandard2.1` | A standalone PDB with SHA-256 hashes and Source Link |
| `CommunityToolkit.Diagnostics.pdb` | CommunityToolkit.Diagnostics 8.2.2, `lib/netstandard2.1` | A standalone PDB with SHA-1 and SHA-256 hashes side by side |
| `Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream.dll` | Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream 2.1.3, `lib/netstandard2.1` | An assembly with an embedded PDB and Source Link |
| `Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream.1.2.2.nupkg` | Microsoft.IO.RecyclableMemoryStream 1.2.2, the whole package | Standalone PDBs with SHA-1 hashes and no Source Link, beside assemblies that embed none |
